notes.title: Announcing Coloring Voxels!
notes.content:
[h2]Coloring Pixels 2![/h2]
The long-awaited sequel to Coloring Pixels is coming soon!
Taking your favourite coloring game from 2D Pixels to 3D Voxels! Experience color-by-numbers like never before in our evolution of the Coloring genre!


[h2]Coloring Voxels[/h2]
Taking Coloring Pixels to a whole new level in the highly anticipated 3D sequel! Don't just colour the outside of a 3D object; build it yourself, block by block! Build up your creations layer by layer, level by level, to create a whole diorama tens of thousands of voxels big.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33218193/f982614ca36958b6acfa42c261b808537c2187f5.gif[/img] 

Relive the calming and creative atmosphere of Coloring Pixels in our new 3D-based coloring game! From the music and art style to the gameplay and satisfying progression, relax and get creative with every level you build, in a format you already know and love.

Wishlist here to stay up-to-date with development and get involved with Steam Next Fest! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3634590?utm_source=announce1_wool


[h3]Patreon Early Access[/h3]
If you can't wait for Next Fest or the full release in August, then check out our Patreon page here, where the top-tier supporters can get access to the Coloring Voxels Demo right now!
[url=https://www.patreon.com/c/toastielabs]https://www.patreon.com/c/toastielabs[/url]

notes.title: The Eggstravaganza has Begun!
notes.content:
[h1]Eggstravaganza![/h1]

A three-week-long event in our games! Celebrate Spring and Easter in style this year with the brand-new Eggstravaganza in-game event! A calming Spring backdrop along with falling eggs to decorate the screen whilst you play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/c7da8318785af351838d3fbf52628828a482a86b.gif[/img]

Make sure you have "Seasonal Events" turned "On" in the settings to take part in this spring and egg-themed fun event!

The event will be running from the 1st of April all the way to the 21st every year! Play during this month to enjoy this three-week-long event!


[h1]Skystead Ranch Eggstravaganza[/h1]

The largest Eggstravaganza event is in Skystead Ranch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2399570/Skystead_Ranch/

During the Eggstravaganza event, you will be able to hunt amongst all of the new event-themed decorations to find as many eggs as you can! Use these eggs from your hunt to unlock 8 brand-new buildable island decorations! 

If you build enough you might even attract a brand new Skylet too! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33218193/4a386b82f0b6595e19c750a24a7b1372807827fe.png[/img]

notes.title: WooLoop in 2024
notes.content:
[h1]New DLC, Achievements and more![/h1]

A massive thank you to all of you for supporting WooLoop over the year! It has almost been a whole year since we released WooLoop last January already!

2023 saw 12 DLC, 372 Levels and 129,000 unique players playing WooLoop over the year! That is absolutely staggering for a small indie studio like us! Thank you all so much!

Your support is what motivates us and allows us to keep on doing what we love. Making games for you all to enjoy. 💖

[h1]DLC in 2024[/h1]

When we released WooLoop way back in January 2023, we committed to 12 additional DLC Galleries. From Fantasy, Food, Nature and to the most recent, Advent. We have achieved that goal! 

Thank you all for your interest and for playing along with us throughout the year.

[h2]But what does that mean for the future of WooLoop?[/h2]

Don't worry! We are now committed to an additional 6 DLC that we will be releasing over 2024, starting this January with the upcoming Science Gallery! 🔬

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/5febbc3bf3c174433cec7664167ab033ccd3b877.jpg[/img]

We will be releasing DLC on a bi-monthly schedule all the way up to December, so there'll be plenty more wrapping and looping for you to get tangled up in.

[h2]Get involved[/h2]

The Science DLC was voted for by our very own [url=https://www.patreon.com/toastielabs]Patreon[/url] supporters! 

But you don't need to be a Patreon to have your say. Join our Discord and share with us what Gallery ideas you would like to see in WooLoop.

These suggestions go into a list for all our Discord users to vote on, the top 5 voted of these suggestions will be passed over to our Patreons every other month to make the final decision on what DLC we will all see next!

So don't wait around, join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/toastielabs-750363631279014079]Discord[/url] now and have your say on what themes and styles we should do next in WooLoop!

[h1]Achievements[/h1]

A long-awaited change is coming right now!

Upon release of WooLoop, we were only able to add 100 achievements, and these didn't even count towards your Steam profile! Boooo! 👎

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/958660c990b0f37c1f9e5fb51acbb598c9e97640.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/48db94eae2b1724da3336a49e7350df72860b8f5.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/958660c990b0f37c1f9e5fb51acbb598c9e97640.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/a6cb991363a2282d4fd2c0a6dd2fb48421188c20.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/5aaa9aec3adb412002d889a444a04db604c288fa.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/958660c990b0f37c1f9e5fb51acbb598c9e97640.png[/img]

Thankfully, due to your continued love and support of WooLoop, Steam has recognised our game and we can now add more Steam achievements that will also be counted on your profiles! Yayyy! 🥳

We have been hard at work this week making all of the achievement icons and getting them uploaded to Steam. Make sure you launch your game and reopen any completed levels to trigger the new achievements.

[b]Note[/b]: [i]We have focused on getting the achievements uploaded in English only for the moment so that they are available ASAP. 

To our beloved worldwide players who play WooLoop in other languages than English, we will be making sure all the achievements are localised to all of the Steam-supported languages soon.tm

Thank you for your patience! 💞[/i]

[h1]More![/h1]

The best way we can think for you to get more WooLoop; is to make it possible to play WooLoop wherever you go!

That's why this year, WooLoop will be coming to Nintendo Switch!

Release dates and more detailed information will be available soon so make sure you keep an eye on your inbox for more news on WooLoop on the Nintendo Switch! 

[h1]Thank you![/h1]

WooLoop, and ToastieLabs, wouldn't be where it is today without your love and support.

So from all of us here at ToastieLabs, thank you!

notes.title: Brand New Winter Event!
notes.content:
[h1]Christmas Events![/h1]

[h3]"Why is it snowing on my Artwork?"[/h3]

If you have played our other titles, like Coloring Pixels, you will know we all love the Christmas Season and like to celebrate in style! WooLoop is no exception.
You will notice that no matter what image you are playing, there are snowflakes falling all around your beautiful creations and melting at the bottom of the screen!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/6e8ab665202dc767be9d98243a39c07c4ff6b5f7.gif[/img]

This is our brand-new Christmas Seasonal Effect! 
During the whole month of December, from the 1st to the 31st (and for every December yet to come!), to get us all in the Christmas spirit we have added this wintery theme for you all you enjoy! 
If you find the snow too distracting, we have you covered. You can choose to take part by enabling or disabling "Seasonal Effects" on the settings page.

The seasonal effect will play on the Advent Gallery all year round so don't worry about missing out!

[h3]Advent Calendars![/h3]

As it is officially December, we can start opening our Advent Calendars! 
This includes this month's "Advent Gallery" DLC! With this DLC, all images are locked behind a numbered door so we can count down the days until Christmas one WooLoop image at a time! We've even added 3 more images to the DLC at no extra cost to make sure you can count down all 24 days to Christmas!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42259533/11402d680b8ac7f4aabd65556bae2b9dae2578db.gif[/img]

No Peeking! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213381

From the 4 of us here at ToastieLabs, 
Thank you for playing WooLoop and Merry Christmas to you all! ʕ•ᴥ•ʔ

notes.title: WooLoop Major Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]First Week is a Success - Thank You![/h1]
WooLoop has been downloaded and played by so many of you! Your reception of the game has completely blown us away and we can't thank you enough! ❤

You have all played enough collectively for over 4 and a half years of playtime! For one week of gameplay that is staggering! Well done!

All of your feedback and comments are welcome, thank you to everyone who has helped identify improvements and suggestions for the game, a lot of which we have addressed in this patch.
Please keep your comments coming, either on Discord, Steam or even on our Website, so we can keep improving WooLoop to the best of our abilities.

[h1]A Note on Achievements[/h1]
This patch brings Gallery 5, which was missing from the launch of the game. The Gallery has 21 images just like all the rest, however; Only the first 6 levels have achievements tied to them. The reason for this is that we have hit the limit of 100 achievements that are linked to new games. 

Once we pass Steam's checks and become an official release on Steam, we will be updating the Achievement list to include the rest of Gallery 5 and beyond. Thank you for your understanding.

[h1]Next Weeks DLC[/h1]
In case you missed it, we have the first DLC for WooLoop releasing next Friday! The Fantasy DLC adds a whole new Gallery to the game with 21 new images for you to Loop! 

All images are in the Fantasy Genre so will cover things magical and wonderful from start to finish.

Available on the 27th of January for $0.99/£0.79 or your regional equivalent: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2213370/WooLoop__Fantasy_Pack/

We are only a very small dev team and drastically unequipped and inexperienced to deal with matters like this. Our game is not intended to demonstrate any political or world events, we have heard your complaints about the change and agree with the points you made. We are truly sorry, and we hope the new Bonus Gallery level helps show our appreciation to our community. We <3 you all, you are amazing!

[*] [b]Dark Mode Improvements[/b] - Multiple changes to dark mode, to make the game much easier to play at night!
[*] New [b]"Always Show Rope Length"[/b] Setting (Default Off) - When enabled, the currently selected rope length and progress is visible in the top left of the screen. This is also viewable by pressing tab.
[*] [b]Main Menu Scrolling[/b] - The main menu gallery scroll position is remembered when you return from a level.
[*] New [b]"Disable Autopanning"[/b] Setting (Default Off) - When enabled, the automatic movement you get when completing a rope is disabled.
[*] New [b]"Autopanning Speed"[/b] Setting (Default 1x) - Adjusts the speed of the auto movement.
[*] New [b]"Disable Keyboard Cursor Movement"[/b] Setting (Default Off) - From this update panning with the keyboard will also move the mouse cursor. Enabling this setting disables the behaviour.
[*] New [b]"Large Cursor"[/b] Setting (Default Off) - When enabled, the cursor is swapped with a much larger and visible version.
[*] New [b]"Zoom Speed"[/b] Setting (Default 1x) - Alters the speed at which you can zoom in and out of a level.
[*] New [b]"Scroll Speed"[/b] Setting (Default 1x) - Alters the speed at scrolling with the mouse wheel affects UI.

[*] Main Menu Logo Localisation.
[*] Multiple Level Adjustments

[*] World Map
[list][*] Fixed rope instructions around Hungary.
[*] Adjusted pins around Greenland to ensure instructions are correct.
[*] Removed Taiwan. We have received lots of anger and negative reviews regarding Taiwan being represented as a separate country from China. We didn't intend to take a political stance on this issue for one side or the other, it certainly isn't our place. We apologize for any offence we may have caused, and hope that we can put this behind us. Removing the island of Taiwan completely allows us to not be forced to take a side.[/list]

[/list]

[*] Panning with the keyboard now pauses auto panning in a similar way to right-clicking does.

notes.title: WooLoop Update and Pricing Model
notes.content:
[h1]WooLoop Game Pricing[/h1]

[b]WooLoop will be Free![/b]

Here at ToastieLabs, we believe games should be for everyone. With that in mind, like some of our other titles on Steam, we release games for free and offer optional DLC at the lowest price we can on Steam $0.99!

The game will be Free and offer 5 Galleries (plus 1 Bonus Gallery) of string art to complete! Each Gallery will contain 21 unique pieces of art for you to create.
After some quick maths, this means you will get over 100 levels to play for free when you download WooLoop!

[h2]DLC[/h2]
In order to provide even more levels for you to play, we are committing to offering 12 months of DLC, 1 DLC for each month of 2023!
Each DLC will contain a new Gallery of 21 pieces of art, we are going to be offering these DLC at $0.99 (the lowest price Steam allows).
Each DLC will launch on the 4th Friday of each month, with the exception of December's planned DLC "Advent", which will feature 24 levels and slight changes to the release schedule which we will confirm at a later date.

Over the course of the 12 months of releases, that will be an additional 255 Levels to play!

We hope this will be plenty to keep you entertained through the year 2023.

Also, make sure to join our Discord as we will be doing monthly giveaways for each DLC!

It has been a hectic couple of weeks where we have made many updates to the appearance of the game in order to look as good as possible for the Game Trailer which we have just started editing!

[*] Fixed UI instruction wiggle

Most of the adjustments were for visual updates in order to make the game as aesthetic as possible when recording clips for the game trailer which will be released in the coming weeks.

This along with multiple new levels as we are ramping up level creation in preparation for sharing Early Access keys for marketing purposes!

[list]
[*] Added a new Accessibility tab in the Settings menu
[*] Added a new setting "Edge Of Screen Panning" (defaulted to on) - When enabled, the screen can pan when you reach the edge of the screen with a rope.
[*] Added a new setting "Panning Speed" (defaulted to 1x) - This setting lets you control the speed at which the edge of the screen panning setting and keyboard controls move the camera.
[*] Added a new setting "Dark Mode" (defaulted to off) - Requested by our community, so we did it <3. This is a work in progress, we hope to add more to this feature in the future.

[list][*] Reduced the number of upcoming instructions visible at once
[*] The changing colour of instructions is much more responsive. Now light blue should always be the instruction you need to complete, and dark blue is a previous instruction.
[*] When an instruction is offscreen, if it is light blue it will always be full scale[/list]
[*] Main Menu Scroll bars have been added
[*] Main Menu scroll speed has been increased
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced Panning Speed and made slight adjustments based on how zoomed in you are
[*] Fixed multiple occurrences of anticlockwise instructions sometimes being incorrect
[/list]

[h1]What's coming next?[/h1]
More Next Fest!
We were amazed at how well you all seemed to enjoy our live broadcast yesterday, we have a second live stream scheduled for tomorrow, Thursday the 6th at 1pm BST. Make sure you stop by again to say hello and get involved with any questions you may have for us, the developers.

We are spending the week analysing all the data and feedback we get from players and will be posting a wrap-up of all our findings. This will let you know what improvements to the game we will be making for the full release in January based on your own feedback!

Thank you all for playing!

notes.title: WooLoops Demo build is live!
notes.content:
[h1]WooLoop Demo![/h1]
The free WooLoop Demo is available right now! We have made the game available early, ahead of the October Next Fest starting next week. So if you would like to give our game a try now is the time to do so!

The full release of the game will be free so the Demo shows off a snippet of what the game will be upon release. Jump in now to try a variety of 18 different levels - many more of which will be available at the full release of WooLoop next year.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1878910

We are still in the process of developing WooLoop so expect there to be differences between the Demo experience and the final product. 

With that in mind, we are actively seeking feedback. Please fill out the after-game questionnaire to let us know how you found your time with WooLoop! As well as this, please jump into our [url=https://discord.gg/TqSxnCnjY6]Discord[/url] server where we have dedicated chat rooms to talk directly to the Devs about WooLoop.

A lot of the updates you see below come from community feedback!

[h1]V0.103 Patch Notes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Added a Game Tutorial
[*] Added Game Localisation to Steam store pages for multiple languages
[*] Added screen panning when dragging the rope to the edge of the screen
[/list]

[list]

[*] Fixed a bug that would incorrectly inform you of making a mistake interacting with a starting instruction
[*] Fixed multiple occurrences of anticlockwise instructions sometimes being incorrect
[/list]

[h1]What's Next[/h1]
We are collecting and reviewing all of the feedback being provided by our players. From this, and our in-house QA, we are constantly improving the WooLoop experience to make it the best we can!

You can follow along on our progress on all of our socials or by stopping by on Fridays on the store page to watch the Devs live stream WooLoop.


Give the demo a try today and watch how the game progresses up to release!
